definitions.explanation: a Japanese food made from mashed tofu mixed with vegetables, then deep-fried

examples.japanese: がんもどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I add ganmodoki to the simmered dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧がんもどき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
がんもどき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しく→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Ganmodoki absorbs the broth and becomes very delicious.

notes:
がんもどき is a traditional Japanese fried tofu ball, popular in simmered dishes.

WRITING:
- Can be written as {雁擬|がんもどき} but usually in hiragana
- {雁|がん} (wild goose) + {擬|もど}き (imitation)
- Originally meant to imitate the taste of wild goose

SHORTENED FORM:
- Often called がん⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ for short

INGREDIENTS:
- Mashed ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧ (tofu)
- Mixed with vegetables like ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧, ⟦{牛蒡|ごぼう}→牛蒡：13484_gobou⟧, ⟦{蓮根|れんこん}→蓮根：13994_renkon⟧
- Sometimes includes ⟦{山芋|やまいも}→山芋：22494_yamaimo⟧ (mountain yam) as binder
- Deep-fried until golden

COMMON DISHES:
- ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧ (oden hot pot)
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered dishes)
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧ (miso soup)

PREPARATION TIP:
- Often blanched ({油抜|あぶらぬ}き) to remove excess oil before simmering

REGIONAL NAME:
- Called ひろうす or ひりょうず in the Kansai region
